highlights.title: Show HN: ThoughtDAG – An editable context graph for LLM conversations
highlights.summary: ThoughtDAG is an editable context graph for LLM conversations
highlights.detail: ThoughtDAG allows users to visualize and edit the context of large language model conversations, providing a unique approach to understanding and interacting with AI models. This tool has potential applications in areas such as chatbots and virtual assistants.

highlights.title: cordiverse/cordis
